primes.title: The Chord Factory
primes.subtitle: Where every number plays its own sound

sound.title: Every number has a sound
sound.intro: 🎛️ **Welcome to the Chord Factory!** In this factory, every number has its own sound. Press the numbers and just listen. Some sound rich and full… and some sound all alone. Explore at least 4 numbers!
sound.powerHint: The machines are still asleep. Wake them up!
sound.tryOne: Press a number to hear its sound!

sort.title: The lonely notes
sort.intro: 👂 **Listen closely.** Try 8. Now try 7. Hear the difference? Some numbers make a full chord — and some just won't. Listen to each number (or watch its blocks) and sort it into the right basket!
sort.retry: Hmm, listen again… is it a full chord, or one lonely note?
sort.done: You sorted them all! Your ears discovered a secret of mathematics… 🌟

reveal.title: Meet the solo singers
reveal.intro: 🌟 **The big reveal!** The solo singers have a name: **prime numbers**. Here is the whole family — each prime has its very own note and its very own color, in every corner of this factory, forever.
reveal.keySentence: A prime is a number that can't be broken into smaller pieces. So it sings alone.
reveal.tapHint: Tap each prime to hear its note!

factory.title: The Chord Factory floor
factory.intro: 🏭 **Now YOU run the factory!** Mix prime notes to build new numbers. Press the 2-note and the 3-note — out comes 6, playing its chord! Press 2, 2, 3 — out comes 12. Every number is built from prime notes. Build 3 different numbers!
factory.empty: Press prime notes to start mixing…

detective.title: The Chord Detective
detective.intro: 🕵️ **A mystery chord is playing!** Which prime notes are hiding inside? The gray blocks show how many notes to find. Listen, press the primes you think are in there, and check your guess. Solve all 5 mysteries to earn your badge!
detective.emptyGuess: Press prime notes to build your guess…
detective.hintUnlocked: Detective tip: try “Show the colors” for a clue! 🎨
detective.badgeText: You can hear the primes hiding inside any number. Case closed! 🕵️🎼

orchestra.title: The Royal Orchestra
orchestra.intro: 👑 **The grand finale!** The drum plays every 2 beats. The shaker every 3. The bell every 5. You can always predict them. But the golden trumpet plays on the **prime** beats — and nobody in the world can predict its rhythm, because primes have none. Press play and listen for the trumpet!
orchestra.cicadaText: Real cicadas hide underground for exactly 13 or 17 years — prime numbers! Because primes share their rhythm with nobody, the cicadas almost never wake up in the same year as the hungry animals that follow shorter cycles. Nature discovered prime numbers long before people did. ✨

skills.hearsDifference: Some numbers sound rich, some sing alone
skills.definition: A prime can't be broken into smaller pieces
skills.buildingBlocks: Every number is built from prime notes
skills.factorDetective: I can find the primes hiding inside a number

primes.finished: You discovered two great secrets: every number is built from prime notes — and the primes themselves follow a rhythm nobody can predict. The whole kingdom of numbers plays your music now. 🎼✨
